result:
The first-time profile page right after signup now shows only the quick questions and the Continue button. Running history and Delete account appear on the normal profile page once the profile is filled in. I checked both pages in a real browser on a copy of your data. The five test suites I ran pass (general, week view, running history, mandatory fields and delete account), your real database's fingerprint stayed the same, and nothing is committed.

- **Form errors:** if someone makes a mistake on the first-time form, the page reloads with the error and still shows only the questions.
- **After filling it in:** the page then reads "Your profile" with both sections under the form as before, and Delete account still works.

The only file changed is `templates/profile.html`.

Restart the app to see this. The login and signup pages are unchanged.
